grammar.label: will — predictions and opinions about the future
grammar.form: I think … will / probably will / won't
grammar.meaning: what the speaker believes will happen

explanation.en: Use will for what you think or believe about the future, often with 'I think' or 'probably'.
explanation.uz: Kelajak haqidagi fikringiz uchun — ko'pincha 'I think' yoki 'probably' bilan.

grammar.positive_example: I think it will rain tomorrow.
grammar.negative_example: I think it will to rain tomorrow.

l1_notes.uz: Ingliz tilida inkor odatda 'I don't think…' ga ko'chadi.

grammar.label: may / might — possibility
grammar.meaning: something is possible but not certain

explanation.en: may and might both mean 'perhaps'. Neither changes for person and neither takes 'to'.
explanation.uz: may va might — ikkalasi ham 'balki' degani. Shaxs bo'yicha o'zgarmaydi, 'to' olmaydi.

grammar.positive_example: I might go to the party.
grammar.negative_example: I might to go to the party.

l1_notes.uz: 'maybe' (balki, ravish) va 'may be' (bo'lishi mumkin) — boshqa narsalar.

grammar.label: time clauses with present for future
grammar.form: when / as soon as / before / after / until + present simple

explanation.en: After when, as soon as, before, after and until, use the present simple for future meaning.
explanation.uz: when, as soon as, before, after, until dan keyin kelasi zamon EMAS, hozirgi zamon ishlatiladi.

grammar.positive_example: I will call you when I arrive.
grammar.negative_example: I will call you when I will arrive.

l1_notes.uz: G-098 bilan bir xil qoida — 'will' faqat bosh gapda.

exponents.text: It's a small town in the north of the country.
There's a park and two schools.
It's quiet but there isn't much to do.
It's about two hours from Tashkent.

functions.label: Giving an opinion and a reason

exponents.text: I think it's a good idea because it saves time.
In my opinion, it's too expensive.
For me, the best thing is the price.
I don't think it's a good idea.

functions.label: Telling a simple story about the past

exponents.text: Last summer I went to Bukhara.
First we… then we… after that we…
In the end, we decided to stay another day.

body.speaker: Kamola
body.text: Look at that cliff. And there is a small waterfall under it.

body.speaker: Sarah
body.text: The scenery here is wonderful. I did not know this place.

body.speaker: Kamola
body.text: It is grey today. I think it will rain this afternoon.

body.speaker: Sarah
body.text: It might rain, but it may stop quickly.

body.speaker: Kamola
body.text: When it stops, we will walk up to the cave.

body.speaker: Kamola
body.text: Forty minutes. The way goes near the stream.

body.speaker: Sarah
body.text: Then we will be back before sunset.

body.speaker: Kamola
body.text: Yes. And after we come down, we will have tea in the village.

body.speaker: Sarah
body.text: Very good. I will take a photo of the landscape first.
